name: @belolipetsky/yookassa-integration-mcp
description: Read-only local MCP server for the YooKassa Codex integration agent

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js && node scripts/strip-trailing-whitespace.mjs dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
